title: Craftable Cinnabar
description: Adds Cinnabar renewability through a recipe including Sulfur and Netherrack!
body:
Cinnabar was added along with Sulfur in Chaos Cubed, but unlike Sulfur, it is non-renewable, which limits its usage for players in older worlds and players who have mined out the Sulfur Caves in their vicinity. This pack adds a recipe using **2 Sulfur** blocks and **2 Netherrack**, yielding **4 Cinnabar** blocks. - In real life, Cinnabar (HgS) is composed of Mercury and Sulfur. Netherrack is used in place of Mercury because according to Minecraft Education Edition, Netherrack is a compound that includes Mercury. ## ### MintRefresh:
